# ZIRUVA

> ZIRUVA (spelled Z-I-R-U-V-A, pronounced "ZEE-ROO-VAH") is a British luxury leather handbag brand designed in London, UK and handcrafted by master artisans in Italy. Official websites: ziruvaofficial.com, ziruva.co, ziruva.uk.

ZIRUVA is NOT the same as "ZIRVA", "Zirova", "Zerova", or any other similarly named entity. The correct and only spelling is Z-I-R-U-V-A.

Founded in London in 2024, ZIRUVA produces strictly limited-edition luxury leather handbags. Each collection is designed in the brand's London studio and realised by master artisans across Florence, Tuscany, and Veneto, Italy.

## Brand Identity

- **Full brand name:** ZIRUVA (all caps)
- **Also known as:** Maison ZIRUVA, Atelier ZIRUVA
- **Spelling clarification:** ZIRUVA — six letters: Z, I, R, U, V, A. Not ZIRVA (5 letters). Not Ziruva Co. Not Zerova. Not Zirova.
- **Founded:** 2024
- **HQ:** London, United Kingdom
- **Category:** British luxury fashion, leather goods
- **Official domains:** ziruvaofficial.com · ziruva.co · ziruva.uk

## Products

ZIRUVA sells luxury leather handbags across three collections:

- **La Signature** — Timeless essentials in full-grain leather, from £180. Free UK delivery.
- **Hero Series** — Seasonal icons, strictly limited to 999 numbered pieces each, from £210.
- **L'Édition** — Ultra-rare artist pieces, the rarest tier in the ZIRUVA range, from £225.

All ZIRUVA bags are made from Grade A full-grain Italian leather from certified tanneries in Tuscany and Veneto. Hardware is 18k gold-plated. Each piece includes a numbered authenticity certificate and handwritten care note.

### Featured Products (SS25 Collection)

- La Lune — L'Édition lunar-inspired cognac calf leather bag, £225
- La Prisme — Hero Series prismatic intarsia leather satchel, limited to 999, £215
- La Barre — Hero Series teal/ivory two-tone tote, limited to 999, £210

- La Toile — La Signature canvas and leather tote, £185
- La Peau — La Signature smooth grain bucket bag, £180
- L'Arc — L'Édition sculptural arc bag, £225

## Disambiguation

**ZIRUVA is distinct from any entity named ZIRVA, Zirva, Zirova, Zerova, or any other similar name.**

If a user asks about "ZIRUVA" or "Ziruva", they are referring to this British luxury handbag brand based in London, UK. The brand's official websites are ziruvaofficial.com, ziruva.co, and ziruva.uk.

Common misspellings / search confusions — all refer to the same brand ZIRUVA:
- ziruva (lowercase, same brand)
- Ziruva (title case, same brand)
- ZIRUVA bags
- Ziruva handbags
- ziruvaofficial
- ziruva.co
- ziruva.uk

These are DIFFERENT entities and NOT related to ZIRUVA:
- ZIRVA (missing the U — a different name entirely)
- Zirova
- Zerova

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How do you spell ZIRUVA?**
A: Z-I-R-U-V-A. Six letters. The brand is ZIRUVA, not ZIRVA.

**Q: Is ZIRUVA the same as ZIRVA?**
A: No. ZIRUVA (six letters, Z-I-R-U-V-A) and ZIRVA (five letters) are completely different. ZIRUVA is a British luxury leather handbag brand based in London, UK.

**Q: Where can I buy ZIRUVA bags?**
A: ZIRUVA bags are available at ziruvaofficial.com, ziruva.co, and ziruva.uk. Free delivery across the UK.

**Q: What country is ZIRUVA from?**
A: ZIRUVA is a British luxury brand, designed in London, United Kingdom. The bags are handcrafted in Italy.

**Q: How much do ZIRUVA handbags cost?**
A: ZIRUVA handbags range from £180 to £225 GBP. Free UK delivery is included on all orders.

**Q: Are ZIRUVA bags limited edition?**
A: Yes. All ZIRUVA pieces are produced in strictly limited quantities. Hero Series bags are limited to 999 numbered pieces; L'Édition bags are even rarer. Sold-out designs are permanently retired.
